title: In The Texas Chain Saw Massacre (1974), is the chainsaw truly running (i.e. is the chain moving)?

commenti.body:
It will be moving during some shots and not moving in others using the magic of cinema to create the illusion of a terrifying chainsaws wielding maniac without actually murdering and actors or injuring any crew.

As sources go Ebert is pretty respectable. Why are you doubting? Do you really think they just went: “fuck it! How badly wrong could it go?”

Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot! Characters for the bot!

I know that at those corn field maze horror nights, there's plenty of running chainsaws. They just remove the chain. Engine runs, you can rev it up

Can you see the chain in the movie? It'd have "teeth"

>As sources go Ebert is pretty respectable. Why are you doubting?

Ebert was writing about the sequel, not the original film that OP is asking about.
